objective: Test whether local delay regression is a useful additional condition for bounded criticality-feedback requeue; retain full research gates.
hypothesis: Cap crossings without local path-delay increases may include unnecessary or harmful supplemental reroutes. This is not established by observed local outcomes.

rule.enabled_condition: At least one connection of the net crosses old criticality below64880 to new criticality at least64880 AND that same connection is routed in consecutive STA inputs AND current path delay_ps strictly exceeds previous path delay_ps.
rule.comparison: Integer picoseconds as provided by existing STA input; strict greater-than with no tuned tolerance.
rule.coalescing: Keep smallest task ID among qualifying crossings. A nonqualifying crossing must not consume the per-net allowance.
rule.ordinary_pending: Existing minimum-iteration, failure and overuse pending reasons remain authoritative. Supplemental allowance consumed only when actually scheduled.
rule.allowance: At most one supplemental requeue per net, unchanged from parent.
rule.budget: Never invalidate retained legal routing solely because feedback remains unserved at iteration budget.
rule.disabled: Guard disabled reproduces unguarded feedback parent; threshold0 reproduces disabled parent.

experiment.reserved_cases: apex2/frisc/elliptic remain unopened for algorithm selection
experiment.matching: All sources/inputs/config/environments identical across groups except threshold and guard flag. Separate isolated source copy; production PR and original net_commit unchanged.

validation: Component checks for strict local increase, equality, decrease, unrouted prior state, qualifying nonrepresentative connection, ordinary-pending precedence, allowance, budget, disabled compatibility.
Five-repeat native legality, output determinism and joint QoR audit.
Independent guard-event and pending replay using all crossing connections; validate source/input hashes.
Full attachment and serial epoch/final version replay.
Semantic auditor corruption checks with refreshed fixture hashes, clearly separate from empirical runs.
acceptance: Do not adopt unless native legality and original joint baseline quality gates pass. Improvements against the negative parent alone are insufficient. No threshold sweep or heldout tuning.
limitations: Local delay outcomes from parent are trajectory observations, not causal or counterfactual evidence; global STA criticality changes can be meaningful even without local delay increases. No novelty, timing closure or board-performance claim.
